name: Nagomibako Innocent Grey Fandisc
original_name: 和み匣 Innocent Greyファンディスク
source: Innocent Grey fandisc featuring short stories and mini-games based on Innocent Grey works such as Cartagra and PP-pianisimo-.
translation: Innocent Grey的Fan Disc，收录了以《恋狱～月狂病～》和《PP-Pianissimo-提线木偶之轮舞》等Innocent Grey作品为基础的短篇故事与小游戏。
